يعلوطوا (form XIII)
# يَعْلَوِّطُوا (yaʕlawwiṭū) /jaʕ.law.wi.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# يُعْلَوَّطُوا (yuʕlawwaṭū) /juʕ.law.wa.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
